beaches.name: Anse Lazio
beaches.description: Granite boulders, clear turquoise water and a sweep of soft white sand make this Praslin shoreline unforgettable.
beaches.highlight: Best for a quiet swim and sunset

beaches.name: Navagio Beach
beaches.description: A dramatic cove framed by pale limestone cliffs and Ionian-blue water on the island of Zakynthos.

beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach
beaches.description: Silica-rich white sand and shifting blue shallows create one of the Whitsundays' most iconic coastal scenes.

beaches.name: Cala Macarella
beaches.description: A sheltered Balearic cove surrounded by pine-covered cliffs, with inviting water in shades of aquamarine.

temples.name: Angkor Wat
temples.description: A monumental Khmer temple complex celebrated for its intricate galleries, towers and extraordinary scale.

temples.name: Kiyomizu-dera
temples.description: A historic hillside Buddhist temple known for its broad wooden veranda and seasonal views across Kyoto.

temples.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
temples.description: A vibrant Dravidian landmark distinguished by towering, richly sculpted gopurams and a living temple tradition.

temples.name: Borobudur
temples.description: A vast Buddhist monument of terraces and stupas set amid the green landscapes of Central Java.
temples.highlight: Visit in the soft morning light

countries.name: Italy
countries.description: Move from Renaissance cities to vineyard-covered hills, dramatic coastlines and a deeply regional food culture.

countries.name: Japan
countries.description: A compelling meeting of quiet gardens, contemporary city life, mountain landscapes and centuries-old craft.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.description: Discover medina lanes, desert horizons, Atlantic towns and a rich tradition of design and hospitality.
countries.highlight: Pair Marrakech with the Atlas Mountains

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.description: A destination of alpine trails, fjords, geothermal landscapes and welcoming small towns.
countries.highlight: Explore by road at an unhurried pace
